name: return31-schedule-a-salt-capped
description: P67 §164(b)(6): MFJ with property tax 35,000 + IL withholding 20,000 = 55,000 of SALT, CAPPED at 40,000. No other Schedule A item — the schedule runs anyway because SALT alone beats the standard deduction.
note: Hand-verified: SALT 55,000 -> cap 40,000 (AGI under the 500,000 phase-down). Deduction 40,000 vs standard 30,000. Taxable 228,946-40,000=188,946. Tax 2,000+7,200+22,000+(8,946 x 24%=2,147)=33,347. PLACEHOLDER rules.
